status.detail: The current SendTextInput helper iterates every wchar_t and sends each as Unicode input, with no special handling for a period. proposed_fixes.title: Preserve punctuation in Keyboard Manager Send text mappings
verification: Enter test@example.com, close/reopen Settings, invoke the shortcut in Notepad, and verify the complete string appears.
Verify punctuation and subsequent text survive mapping reload and multiline text behavior remains unchanged.
plan: Reproduce with test@example.com in a plain text editor and another target application.
Trace the value from Settings serialization and loaded mapping through KeyboardEventHandlers to Helpers::SendTextInput; compare code points at each boundary.

If an earlier parser truncates the value, preserve the full configured string and add a persistence/dispatch test; if the helper receives the complete string, investigate target-side behavior before changing injection.
Add regression coverage for periods and the full email-like text.
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Red hypothesis: the configured text value may be truncated or altered before SendTextInput, or a target app may handle the injected sequence differently. The helper itself has no period-specific handling and the exact boundary is unconfirmed.
